Choose one accessible physical trail. Read the tracks and make a Reason roll. On a Standard result, also learn the most recent danger their trail shows they encountered, and where they encountered it.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Reason
Time
Ten minutes.
Target / range / shape
One accessible physical trail.
Type
Skill / Utility

Read the tracks and make a Reason roll.

Weak
Learn the travelers' direction, approximate number and pace.
Standard
Also learn the most recent danger their trail shows they encountered, and where they encountered it.
Strong
Also find a usable approach that avoids that danger, if the terrain offers one.

You and up to six companions gain 1 Boon to your next attribute rolls following this trail before it is lost or the scene ends.
